items.title: Professor Longhair (Henry Roeland Byrd) Interview, 1975-11-13
items.q: Sonny Boyd Williams, we worked together at the New York Inn.

ctx.x: Yeah, right, Norbert. Norbert should know how to get in touch with him. He told me he had seen him. Thank you. And I don't know exactly all the details. So after, you know, after you, what was, so the first group you got was with Dupree. You went in.

Not my group, I was just with them. I worked with them. That's the first showing that I appeared with in the public. Mm-hmm. I was with them. Sonny Boyd Williams, we worked together at the New York Inn. Well I made appearance in front of people. Nothing professional.
Yeah, this is just amateur stuff.
